Jinyuan Xu — reference-inspired 3D homepage hero

The scene is adapted from Liangbing (Liam) Zhao's open-source homepage:
https://github.com/liangbingzhao/liangbingzhao.github.io/tree/redesign-3d
Source revision: 964aa2076be23552640e32962f31cac60ccca4cc
Original source files: src/scripts/hero/scene.ts and font.typeface.json.
The source repository supplies an MIT license, included as LICENSE-original.txt.
Its notice credits Copyright (c) 2022 Maruan Al-Shedivat.

Local changes: the name Jinyuan Xu in Comic Sans MS Regular;
uniform warm ivory particles;
transparent seascape composition; explicit pause and reduced-motion behavior;
first-render readiness, fallback lifecycle, and independently bundled assets.
The final name remains a point cloud, with spring-based cursor repulsion and
tap waves. Matte single-face sampling and normal alpha blending replace
extruded, additive surfaces. The original Gaussian denoising opening is preserved.

Bundled runtime dependencies:
- Three.js 0.186.1, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js, MIT.
  Full notice: LICENSE-three.txt.
The fixed name artwork is rendered locally using Comic Sans MS Regular.
No Comic Sans font program or general-purpose glyph collection is distributed.

Legacy source asset (not loaded by the current scene):
- Space Grotesk Bold, https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk,
  Copyright 2020 The Space Grotesk Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
  Full notice: OFL-Space-Grotesk.txt.

esbuild 0.28.2 is used only to build the standalone bundle, not shipped as runtime.
No original photographs, personal text, CV, or publication assets are included.
